text: the free-run test RMSE of the kept PINN network, recomputed from the saved weights

payload.question: To recompute the free-run test RMSE of the kept PINN (A2_h5), I need to run code. Shall I proceed? It will load the weights from silverbox/results/A2_h5.pt with load_model, load the test excerpt from data/SNLS80mV.mat with load_excerpt, and run free_run. It will then report the test RMSE and compare it with the value stored in A2_h5.json. It won't write or overwrite any files.

proposed_step.instruction: In silverbox/silverbox_pinn.py, use load_excerpt (data/SNLS80mV.mat), load_model (silverbox/results/A2_h5.pt, with the config in A2_h5.json) and free_run to recompute the free-run RMSE of the kept PINN A2_h5 on the TEST segment, using the saved weights. Don't train. Don't write or overwrite any files on disk. Print the test RMSE, and also the value stored in A2_h5.json (and kept.json) for comparison. Report exactly what the tools return, and report any traceback.
